:::{#exm-prediction-bias}
#### Computing the bias of a prediction

Suppose $\truemeanf{\predvar} = 10$,
and the [predictions](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) $\predvalf{\predvar}$,
over repeated [training sets](#def-training-set),
average $11$.
Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bias{\predval}
&= \Epredval - \truemeanf{\predvar} && \text{(@thm-prediction-bias-average-fit)} \\
&= 11 - 10 \\
&= 1.
\end{aligned}
$$

The squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias) is $1^2 = 1$,
the value in @exr-epe-three-sources.

:::
